statement: Iran imposes a verified closure or blockade of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial oil tankers, lasting at least 24 continuous hours, with the closure occurring between 2026-10-03 and 2026-11-28.
resolution: Reuters, AP, or Lloyd's List Intelligence report commercial tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz were halted for 24 or more continuous hours due to Iranian military or paramilitary action, within the window.
failure_condition: Commercial tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz continue without a sustained Iranian-attributed halt of 24 or more hours during the window.

statement: At least one additional militant attack causing five or more fatalities occurs in Pakistan between 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-24.
resolution: Two or more of AP, Reuters, AFP, Dawn, or Geo News report a single Pakistan attack in the window killing five or more people, attributed to militant action.
failure_condition: No single attack inside Pakistan during the window is confirmed by two or more named outlets to have caused five or more fatalities.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury yield closes at or above 5.30 percent on 2026-11-13. Reference: 5.18 percent on 2026-09-26.
resolution: Treasury.gov or FRED series DGS10 shows the 10-year Treasury par yield closing at or above 5.30 percent on 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury par yield closes below 5.30 percent on 2026-11-13.

statement: WTI crude oil closes at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13. Reference: 92.41 USD per barrel on 2026-09-26.
resolution: EIA or exchange settlement data shows WTI crude closing at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: WTI crude settles below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-11-13.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds a new CVE for a Kiteworks, WSO2, or Adobe Commerce product, dateAdded between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog lists a Kiteworks, WSO2, or Adobe Commerce CVE with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No Kiteworks, WSO2, or Adobe Commerce CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded in the window.

statement: Brazil's October 4, 2026 presidential election fails to produce a first-round majority winner, triggering a second-round runoff on 2026-10-25.
resolution: The TSE confirms no first-round candidate reached 50 percent plus one of valid votes on 2026-10-04, and a runoff is held 2026-10-25.
failure_condition: The TSE certifies an outright first-round majority winner, or no runoff is held on 2026-10-25.

statement: CNN remains excluded from the standing White House press pool rotation for Air Force One travel as of 2026-11-16.
resolution: WHCA statements or two independent outlets confirm CNN is excluded from the standard Air Force One pool rotation on 2026-11-16.
failure_condition: CNN is confirmed as part of the standard Air Force One press pool rotation on or before 2026-11-16.

statement: A US, European, or UK law enforcement body announces an indictment, arrest, or sanctions action against a ShinyHunters- or Clop-linked individual or entity between 2026-10-03 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: DOJ, Europol, or NCA publishes an announcement, or a US court unseals an indictment, naming a ShinyHunters or Clop affiliate, dated in the window.
failure_condition: No DOJ, Europol, or NCA action names a ShinyHunters or Clop affiliate during the window.

statement: FEMA issues a major disaster declaration for at least one Northeast US state tied to the late-September 2026 nor'easter, between 2026-09-27 and 2026-10-20.
resolution: FEMA's disaster declarations database lists a major disaster declaration for CT, MA, NJ, NY, or RI tied to this storm, declared in the window.
failure_condition: FEMA's declarations database shows no major disaster declaration for the named states tied to this storm by the deadline.
